title: Argentinian Pork Stir Fry
description: A classic Argentinean dish with a twist of a stir fry, made with tender pork, crunchy vegetables and a flavorful sauce.
instructions: 1. Cut the pork loin into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and black pepper.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of harmonious oil blend in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
5. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of harmonious oil blend to the skillet.
6. Add the sliced onion and red bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
7. Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
8. Add the stir-fry sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
9. Return the pork to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
10. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the pork is cooked through.
12. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
